The recipe

Five steps to read a table

1
Current snapshot
max(snapshot_id) from ducklake_snapshot
2
The table
ducklake_table, valid now
3
The data path
ducklake_metadata
4
Files valid at that snapshot
ducklake_data_file: begin ≤ s, end > s or empty
5
Read them
read_parquet
